messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v3.2.1 -> 15% traffic (canary). Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. release_notes: 'improved kv-cache backpressure, embedding perf fixes'. :rocket:

morgan: Hold — seeing a minor uptick in 5xxs from eu-west on the embed endpoint in A/B logs. +0.6% over baseline. Not a huge signal but worth pausing. :eyes:

jen: Confirming — dashboards show spike at 02:03 UTC, tailing errors concentrated at 1.2s latency buckets. Screenshot pasted to thread. Looks correlated with requests that hit quantized runtime path.

sam: Can we pin the canary group to v3.1.9 while we triage? We should avoid full rollback if it's a small config/regression. Pinning means new requests go back to pinned route, existing sessions keep going.

lucy: Agree with pin for safety. Also double-check release_notes for a KMS/config toggle change — if a new flag defaulted to true, could explain env-specific behavior.

ops-oncall: Oncall ready for rollback if we see >=1.5% 5xx sustained for 5m or customer impact. Do we have a quick rollback playbook?

morgan: I ran a quick grep in canary logs — there's a rare codepath hitting an experimental host header normalization. Only in requests routed from eu-west LB. Suspect config rollout that wasn't pinned in infra.

sam: Ok doing a soft pin now: /rollout pin v3.2.1 -> v3.1.9 for canary group. Command: `deployctl traffic set --target canary --version v3.1.9`

deploy-bot: deployctl accepted. Canary traffic pinned to v3.1.9. Observability: continue monitoring. :white_check_mark:

jen: Metrics after pin: 5xx rate dropping back toward baseline within 2 mins. Latency tail shrinking. I think pin avoided a full rollback.

ops-oncall: Great — keep the pin for the remainder of the change window. We'll run a quick blameless postmortem on the config gating and add a checklist to release docs. Who owns the follow-up?

morgan: I'll lead the postmortem. Action items: (1) confirm origin of header normalization flag, (2) add infra gating to deploy checklist, (3) add canary gating alert for quantized runtime path.

lucy: I'll update release notes and add a short note in the change window doc about the pin and why it was applied.

sam: Re-open the canary only when we have a config rollback/patch in staging and a green run. Suggest target: 24h hold and revalidate.

deploy-bot: Logging actions: pin applied by sam at 02:07 UTC, canary -> v3.1.9. Incident tag: CANARY-PIN-4155550000. Thread locked to prevent accidental commands.

jen: Thanks everyone. Small and quick — good coordination. :clap:

ops-oncall: Marking as resolved for now. Will add follow-up to weekly release retro.
